meta.title: feat: add heavy-duty stress test for buildDateRanges function
meta.body_summary: Adds a stress test for buildDateRanges with 2 years of availability, travel schedules, date overrides, OOO entries, and performance monitoring (~35k ranges in ~19s, ~50MB memory).

perf_labels.notes: Devin added a stress test with performance metrics; closed by maintainer without merge and no human review feedback.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Small change (158 lines added in one test file). This is a test addition, not a code optimization, and was closed without merge, suggesting the maintainer did not find it appropriate to incorporate at this time.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review or comment explaining the closure; only bot comments (Devin, CodeRabbit skip, delve-auditor security). Maintainer emrysal closed without comment after ~3.5 days.
review_details.performance_claim: buildDateRanges can generate ~35,000 date ranges in ~19 seconds with ~50MB memory under the test scenario.
review_details.rejection_signals: No explicit rejection signal; PR closed by maintainer without comment after inactivity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin created a comprehensive stress test as requested, but the maintainer closed the PR without feedback, indicating a process gap where test-only contributions may not align with immediate project needs or require prior discussion.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The test itself provides a way to reproduce the performance numbers, but it was not validated by any maintainer.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix or rework cycle occurred.
